name: HubSpot
description: Loads HubSpot companies, contacts, leads, deals, lists, forms, form submissions and associations into records, following every page, or searches contacts and companies.
introductoryText:
### HubSpot connector

Loads records from your HubSpot account, one action at a time:

- **Companies, Contacts, Leads, Deals**: every record, with the properties you name (or HubSpot's defaults).
- **Lists**, **Forms**, and the **Form submissions** of one form.
- **Search contacts / companies**: records matching a text, such as a name or e-mail domain.
- **Associations**: which records of one object are linked to which of another (contacts to companies, deals to contacts...).

**How to set it up**: copy the access token of a HubSpot private app with the read scopes for the objects you need (such as `crm.objects.contacts.read`) into the block. HubSpot stopped new private apps being created on 26 October 2026; existing ones (now listed as legacy apps) keep working. See the block's README.

Every page is loaded. Dates come out as dates (UTC); property values are text, as HubSpot sends them.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

options.name: key
options.title: Private app access token
options.description: The access token of a HubSpot private app (Settings > Integrations > Private apps), with read scopes for the objects you load.

options.name: params
options.title: Search text or form ID
options.description: For the search actions, the text to look for (in names, e-mail addresses, domains and other default searchable properties). For Form submissions, the form's ID, as listed by the Forms action.

options.name: properties
options.title: Properties
options.description: Optional, comma-separated HubSpot property names to load for Companies, Contacts, Leads, Deals and the searches, such as name, domain, industry, annualrevenue. Empty: HubSpot's default properties (for contacts: e-mail, first and last name, lifecycle stage).

options.name: from_object_type
options.title: From object
options.description: For Associations: the object type to start from, such as contacts, companies or deals.

options.name: to_object_type
options.title: To object
options.description: For Associations: the object type to find links to.

options.name: object_ids
options.title: From object IDs
options.description: For Associations, optional: comma-separated record IDs of the From object. Empty: every record of the From object.

blockOutputs.label: Records
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record per HubSpot record, list, form, submission or association, depending on the action
